features.name: glucose_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized plasma glucose concentration using training set mean and std, clipped to [-4, 4] for SVM margin stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly normalized glucose is the strongest linear predictor for diabetes; z-scoring centers the SVM hyperplane

features.name: bmi_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized BMI using training set statistics, clipped for outlier robustness
features.expected_model_benefit: BMI is a key diabetes risk factor; normalization ensures equal contribution in linear SVM

features.name: age_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized age using training set statistics
features.expected_model_benefit: Age is a continuous risk factor; normalization aligns scale with other features for SVM

features.name: diabetes_pedigree_log
features.description: Log-transformed diabetes pedigree function to reduce right skew, then normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transform reduces skewness of pedigree distribution, improving linear separability

features.name: glucose_bmi_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of normalized glucose and BMI, approximating a linear projection of two key diabetes risk factors
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two strongest predictors into a single composite score that approximates the dominant linear discriminant direction

features.name: insulin_log_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed and normalized insulin level to handle extreme right skew
features.expected_model_benefit: Insulin has high variance and skew; log transform makes it more linearly useful for SVM

features.name: pregnancies_normalized
features.description: Normalized pregnancy count using training statistics, clipped for outlier robustness
features.expected_model_benefit: Number of pregnancies correlates with diabetes risk; normalization ensures proper SVM scaling

features.name: glucose_to_bmi_ratio
features.description: Ratio of plasma glucose to BMI, capturing metabolic efficiency; log-transformed and normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio captures interaction between glucose and body composition; useful linear feature for SVM margin

features.name: skin_thickness_normalized
features.description: Normalized triceps skin fold thickness, a proxy for body fat percentage
features.expected_model_benefit: Skin thickness correlates with insulin resistance; normalization enables linear contribution

features.name: blood_pressure_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of diastolic blood pressure from population mean, normalized; captures hypertension risk
features.expected_model_benefit: Deviation from normal blood pressure is a risk indicator; absolute deviation is a smooth continuous feature

features.name: metabolic_risk_severity
features.description: Holistic metabolic risk severity score combining glucose level, BMI category, age, and insulin resistance signals into a continuous 0-10 scale. Score 0-3: low risk profile with normal glucose, healthy BMI, younger age. Score 4-6: moderate risk with borderline values in one or more factors. Score 7-10: high risk with elevated glucose (>140), obese BMI (>30), older age (>45), or multiple compounding factors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically grounded composite risk score that captures non-linear interactions between metabolic factors in a single continuous feature useful for SVM

features.name: insulin_glucose_balance_score
features.description: Assessment of insulin-glucose homeostasis balance on a continuous 0-10 scale. Score 0-3: well-balanced with low glucose and proportionate insulin. Score 4-6: mild imbalance with elevated glucose or abnormal insulin-to-glucose ratio. Score 7-10: severe imbalance indicating likely insulin resistance or deficiency, characterized by high glucose with low insulin or extreme insulin values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the physiological relationship between insulin and glucose that is central to diabetes diagnosis; provides a smooth continuous score for linear SVM
